m1.typescript: m1 each role gets only the tools of its specialisation in catalog order

e1.typescript: e1 a role over its budget or given an unknown or unscoped outside tool or a duplicate catalog name is refused

e2.typescript: e2 an irreversible tool is given only by an explicit grant

e3.typescript: e3 a model that accepts forcing gets the native choice and the others get auto with strict tools and one named tool

e4.typescript: e4 a change of tool choice costs the cached messages a change of tools costs everything and a repeat costs nothing

e5.typescript: e5 a reply is checked against the call that was required

e6.typescript: e6 an unknown tool a wrong owner or a bad amount is refused

e7.typescript: e7 the cap is inclusive and an irreversible call needs approval that never lifts the cap

wrong-sorted-names.defect: lists a role's tools alphabetically instead of in catalog order

wrong-no-budget.defect: lets a role have more tools than the budget

wrong-unscoped-extra.defect: grants an outside tool that is not marked as a scoped cross-role tool

wrong-duplicates-ok.defect: accepts two catalog entries with the same name

wrong-irreversible-by-tag.defect: gives an irreversible tool to every role whose specialisation matches

wrong-forces-everywhere.defect: forces the tool choice on models that reject it

wrong-fallback-all-tools.defect: offers every tool in the fallback for a named first tool

wrong-fallback-no-verify.defect: does not ask for the reply to be checked in the fallback

wrong-tools-ignored.defect: does not count a narrower tool list as a change that costs the whole cache

wrong-choice-ignored.defect: does not count a changed tool choice as a cost to the cached messages

wrong-repeat-costs.defect: reports a cost for a request that repeats the previous one

wrong-missed-call-ok.defect: accepts a reply with no tool call when one was required

wrong-any-tool-counts.defect: accepts any tool when a particular one was required first

wrong-default-allow.defect: allows a tool that the policy does not name

wrong-owner-unchecked.defect: does not compare the customer with the verified one

wrong-cap-exclusive.defect: refuses an amount equal to the cap

wrong-approval-lifts-cap.defect: lets an approval allow an amount above the cap

wrong-approval-skipped.defect: allows an irreversible call without an approval

wrong-irreversible-extra-dropped.defect: silently leaves out an irreversible tool that was granted explicitly outside the role's tags
